prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual 2D top-down game floor background, not a screenshot or mockup. Create a polished cozy cartoon courtyard for a raccoon vacuum-cleaning action game. Landscape 3:2. Orthographic overhead camera, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point. The central 90 percent of the image is entirely walkable continuous pale warm sandstone paving: large softly irregular rectangular flagstones with fine seams, restrained mint and cream botanical ceramic mosaic accents near the edges and a subtle circular leaf medallion in the center. A very narrow border along the extreme edges has lush rounded sage leaves, tiny cream flowers and warm terracotta edging. No furniture or objects anywhere in the playable interior, no paths requiring collision. Clean inviting sunlit courtyard, sophisticated hand-painted mobile game art with crisp silhouettes, subtle tactile stone texture, gentle ambient occlusion, upper-left warm light. Pale warm cream ground with low contrast detail so enemies stand out. No characters, no weapons, no dirt, no stains, no text, no UI, no logo, no watermark. The image is the clean floor revealed under removable mud; it should feel rewarding to uncover. Output landscape.

Entire character completely visible with generous transparent padding, single character only, no surrounding decorations. Match a warm sandstone botanical courtyard palette. No realistic fur strands, no 3D plastic toy, no drop shadow.
